comparison_receipt_semantics: Output-checker receipt PASS means execution completed; comparison.json carries EXACT_ATOM_EQUAL, NUMERICAL_SUPPLEMENT_AGREES, NUMERICAL_DISAGREEMENT or unresolved/invalid-point results. Packaging does not infer equality from receipt PASS.
credential_scan: All selected bytes scanned for listed credential formats; no matches. This does not claim detection of every possible secret format.
determinism: Sorted members; mode0644; uid/gid/mtime zero; empty user/group/gzip filename; gzip mtime zero. Same frozen inputs and compression toolchain produce identical archive bytes.

c6_run_01.explanation: The initial res/expr logging selectors did not match emitted metadata. Root requested a stop; CHILD_FAILURE/143 records that stop, not a native physics failure. Preserve the receipt unchanged.

c6_run_02.explanation: Uses reviewed boolean metadata selectors from recipe-v2.json/card-v2.toml. Its own terminal receipt is required; no automatic retry or replacement of run-01 evidence.

stack_sample.explanation: PASS_TOOL/exit 0 records GDB quitting; attachment was denied. No captured stack or paused inferior is claimed.

excluded: compiled binaries and native executable payloads
whole saved state directories; only named certificates, graph/model exports and summaries are selected
the licensed wrapper, which is never opened or hashed
unlisted files, previous archives, PDFs and __pycache__
platform_metadata_scope: measurement-platform.json contains only versions, cpu, affinity_cpu_count and loadavg copied from curated hardware/tool metadata. The original measurement-environment.json remains excluded; no process environment is captured.
watchdog_source_scope: Only the exact previously reviewed ram-watchdog-ps10.py is copied under diagnostics/watchdog with its known SHA256. The licensed wrapper is never read, hashed or archived.
